elements.text: The Copper Kettle contract account card (internal reference GL-CARD-JTS) was prepared on 2025-08-21 by Emma Bennett from the agreement and account notes as the account team's reading of those papers

Copper Kettle's agreement terms include an initial one-year term with annual renewal, ordinary payment within 30 days after invoice issue, non-renewal notice of eight weeks before renewal, and early exit requiring six weeks' notice plus two months of average service charges
Copper Kettle account status was entered by operations as closed at the end of May 2025 with sites inactive; no customer termination notice is attached to the collection register

Under the Copper Kettle agreement, at end of service the parties arrange equipment return, reconcile final invoices, and identify outstanding records; a system status showing a site as inactive does not replace a termination notice

For Copper Kettle, the transfer scenario's per-visit annualised collection revenue of GBP 18187.00 is GBP 6948.28 (61.82 percent) higher than the offer card's negotiated annual route packages totaling GBP 11238.72

Under Annex A of the Copper Kettle agreement, the empty container column is retained from the signed schedule; other sites require acceptance by the parties, and additional operational frequency sheets may be kept with the account records

The Copper Kettle receivables worksheet contained no remittance allocation or customer acknowledgement of the open balances other than the September and November 2024 collection settlements; the account team recorded repeated late settlement and asked finance to separate service debt from charges for delay

Under the Copper Kettle agreement, if a serious breach remains uncorrected for twenty-one days after a written request, the other party may end the service by notice; an extended disruption beyond either party's reasonable control must be reported promptly with affected routes identified, and after seventy-five days of continuing disruption either party may end the affected service without an early-exit charge

Under the Copper Kettle agreement, monthly invoices cover the previous month's service with tax shown separately at 16 percent service tax; late balances carry simple interest at 4.6 percent per year from the day after the due date; the agreement sets no fixed recovery fee, and any other collection expense claim must identify the expense and its basis; outer-route prices require an accepted site quotation

Under the Copper Kettle agreement, parties may review routes and charges at each anniversary using the cost of serving accepted sites, but a revised price takes effect only through a written change signed by both parties; an internal rate sheet or changed invoice template does not amend the agreement, and until a signed change the last agreed charge remains the contractual schedule
Under the Copper Kettle agreement, confidential information is protected for seven years after service ends

The Copper Kettle transfer pack describes a possible transfer of routes, containers and account relationships but records no buyer acceptance, agreed price, or completion date, and does not contain the customer consent required by the signed service agreement
